answer: The ridge holds work receipts rather than names, so the nectar of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, diluted when peers disagree, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Reaching the crystal of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
